content:
incident-bot: PAGER: Priority 1 — shard-17 in us-east showing progressive 5xx spike and request queue growth. (>80% queue depth, error rate 12% over 5m). Auto-alert triggered.

maya: ack, I'm on it. seeing connection resets to provider-A from the edge workers, and long tail on KV lookups. starting live tail of shard logs.

priya: priya (oncall) joining. what's the customer impact?

maya: initial quick check: ~5% of overall traffic from us-east, but a few tenants (acme-corp, bluefin) are seeing 20-40% failures for long-running requests. no database issues.

daniel: can we do a soft provider switch? recommend gradual reroute to provider-b with header-based steering. keep health checks enabled.

rebecca: support: getting 8 escalations about timeouts from acme-corp. They asked for ETA. please update.

maya: plan: 1) enable per-shard soft-failover (25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m windows) 2) apply per-tenant emergency quota reductions for heavy tenants 3) brownout nonessential features (streamed-append, live-highlights) to reduce backend load.

chris: product ok to toggle stream-highlights. set flag for shard-17 only.

alex: network: provider-b has capacity. recommend envoy route weights change, not full BGP.

maya: performing first step now. invoking router API to shift 25%.

maya: ```
POST /internal/routing/shift
payload: {'shard':'shard-17','from':'provider-A','to':'provider-B','percent':25,'mode':'gradual'}
```

ops-bot: ROUTE-CHANGE: Routing weights for shard-17 updated: provider-A 75% -> provider-B 25% (initiated by maya).

priya: observing metrics. queue depth dropping ~15% already. 5xxs down from 12% -> 7% in 3m.

maya: starting tenant quota adjustments for top 10 noisy tenants. applying -30% allowed concurrency for acme-corp and bluefin.

rebecca: support notified acme-corp with a short message: "We're rotating traffic to a fallback provider and limiting some heavy concurrent jobs. Expect intermittent timeouts for long requests for up to 30m. Will update." they acknowledged.

maya: toggled product flag 'stream-highlights' OFF on shard-17.

ops-bot: FLAG-UPDATE: feature 'stream-highlights' disabled on shard-17 (chris).

daniel: metrics look better. 5xxs at 4.2%. decide if we continue to 50% shift.

priya: handoff: I need to step out in 20m. maya, take steady-state, then hand over to daniel when you need pause.

maya: will continue. if we see new regression, we'll roll back to provider-A and re-open.

chris: can we keep a canary header so we can route specific test traffic to provider-B? want to validate output parity.

maya: set canary header 'x-rr-canary: shard-17-check' for 1% test traffic.

ops-bot: CANARY: 1% test traffic to provider-B enabled for shard-17.

priya: good. updating pager notes and attaching mitigations. I'll hand off to daniel at 1769006000.

daniel: oncall ack. will keep monitoring dashboards (errors, latency, cache hit rate). escalate if below expected thresholds.

maya: last check 20m after start: 5xxs at 2.1%, queue depth normalized, acme-corp errors down to 6%. marking incident as mitigated but not resolved — continue observation and postmortem later.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Incident 'edge-shard provider degradation' mitigated. Runbook: create postmortem, capture traffic weights, tenant quota changes, feature flags toggled, and timeline.

priya: thanks team. handing off now.
